description: List due-date overrides on an assignment: different dates or extensions for sections, groups or individual students. Read-only. Use get_my_override for the dates that apply to you.

assignment_id.description: Assignment ID (numeric string). Get it from list_assignments or list_upcoming_assignments.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (one page of results). Smaller is faster.

page.description: Which page of results to show, starting at 1. Use it when a result says there are more.

name: list_assignment_overrides
title: List Assignment Overrides
